role: Speculative enquiry: junior civil designer or civil draftsperson (Mulgrave, Melbourne)
cover_letter_text:
This is a speculative enquiry, not an application for an advertised vacancy: I am asking whether TGVK has junior civil design or drafting work available. Your careers page says you are always looking for engineers, designers and draftsmen and asks for a CV and a formal cover letter. I am looking for work in stormwater design and paving, two services on your civil services page.

I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 and hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering. In the diploma I designed and documented stormwater drainage and pavement systems, along with road geometry and earthworks, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, applying Australian Standards. My portfolio has a road cross section I drew in AutoCAD, with kerbs and drainage. On a community hall renovation in the Philippines in 2019 I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked work against project requirements.

I am based in Melton VIC. I can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and a White Card. Could we arrange a short call?

Marc Masarate
